Common Data For Q. 33 and 34 
 
An SSB transmitter has a 24 volt DC power supply. On 
voice peaks, the current achieves a maximum of 9.3 A. 
33. What is the peak envelope power of the transmitter? 
 
(a) 157.8 
(b) 111.6 W 
 
(c) 223.2 W 
(d) 86.5 W
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-01 (Analog Communication AM & FM).
